text: Businesses from the Danforth have been in touch with my office requesting help in dealing with a problem of driveways that are consistently blocked. Transportation Services has provided language to install No-Parking signs around the driveways to make it clear and obvious to cars that they cannot park there. This will not impact parking on the Danforth as it will only cover the driveway entrance. In order to move this change forward quickly I am asking that you support the recommendations in my letter, which have been provided by Transportation Services.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit parking at all times on the north side of Danforth Avenue, between a point 47.5 metres east Playter Boulevard and a point 3 metres further east. 2. City Council prohibit parking at all time on the north side of Danforth Avenue, between a point 41 metres west of Jackman Avenue and a point 4.5 metres further west.
